title: inquiry.submitted v1.2 (TripPlanner → AA-Booking)
description: One row of tripplanner.outbox / tripplanner.v_inquiry_outbox (payload column). Written in the same transaction as the 'sent' trip event (ADR 0001 decision 6, AA-676). The consumer stores idempotency_key in its own inbox and processes each key once. Producer: AA-TripPlanner-Web backend/assembly/handoff.py. v1.2 (AA-830, S237 decision E7, data standards X3): additive over v1.1 — every leg also carries the catalog tour key (source_system, source_id) of contract catalog.tour.v1, resolved by the producer against catalog.v_tour at send time; source_tour_id is kept unchanged for compatibility. Consumers must accept version 1, 1.1 and 1.2 and key legs on (source_system, source_id), never on source_tour_id (data standards DM-2.2).

version.description: major.minor; 1.2 is additive over 1.1 (and 1); payloads labelled 1 or 1.1 are validated by those files

idempotency_key.description: <trip_id>:<handoff_id>. A re-send after a real edit is a new hand-off with a new key.

handoff_id.description: id of the 'sent' event in tripplanner.trip_events

customer.description: Who sent the inquiry. null = legacy guest hand-off (deprecated by O6: guests must give name + email). customer_id null = contact matched nobody verifiable or matched an existing customer without proof (TripPlanner never links on an unverified match); the fields then carry exactly what this request submitted.

customer_id.description: tripplanner.customers.id when this request created/claimed the customer; null for a contact snapshot

email.description: lower(trim()); required non-null by O6 once the TripPlanner guest form ships

consent.description: explicit contact consent from the registration form

verified.description: true only when the contact was verified by OTP (AA-Booking owns OTP). Consumers must not merge an unverified customer into an existing booking.customers row automatically.

legs.description: Consecutive days taken from the same real AA tour (ADR 0001 decision 5). day_from/day_to are that tour's own day indexes. Key a leg on (source_system, source_id).

source_tour_id.description: Kept for compatibility with v1 / v1.1 readers: the TripPlanner component's tour key as before, which is either a catalog source_id or a version tour_id (it changes on re-upload). Do not key on it; use source_system + source_id.

source_system.description: Catalog key system (catalog.v_tour.source_system). null together with source_id when the producer could not resolve source_tour_id against catalog.v_tour at send time (the tour left the catalog, or the catalog was unreadable); the hand-off is still sent.

source_id.description: Stable catalog tour key (catalog.v_tour.source_id = COALESCE(raw_tours.source_group_id, tour_id)); does not change on re-upload. null exactly when source_system is null.

days.description: One entry per pinned component, in trip-day order (several components can share a day).

custom_days.description: Days the traveller added on top of the AA legs (not part of any tour).
